review_status: One owner admission-cap fix required before release; no additional substantive collector scientific/deployment bug found by source inspection

findings.title: Observed absolute child-stage overrun can still be accepted
findings.evidence: run_child uses began-based waits, but records no cap_exceeded and its success assertion never compares actual elapsed_seconds with ACTIVE+CLEANUP. For example, launch/owner-receipt work can consume the deadline while the child finishes; wait(timeout=0) can then reap an already-exited zero-status child without TimeoutExpired, so timed_out remains false and elapsed>1810 is admitted. This leaves the claimed absolute stage bound unenforced at acceptance.
findings.required_fix: Add actual cap_exceeded = elapsed_seconds > ACTIVE+CLEANUP to CHILD_TERMINAL and reject observed overruns together with the existing exit/reap/error/timeout guards. Preserve unconditional terminal recording, exact owned PID/start/process-group checks, bounded cleanup, no retry and no original-job signals. No collector or scientific-source change is needed.

compatibility_and_scientific_checks: The existing CPU waiter's COMPLETE.complete, owner_and_recorded_children_conservatively_terminal, observed_owned_handles, EXTRACT/READ terminal reaped/exit/timed_out/identity fields and export owner/closure bindings match the new owner's accesses. Fit start_ticks=None retains conservative PID-only live gating, without invented historical identity.
